# TDPdf v1.17.0.0

A fork-sync release pulling the newest useful features and fixes from upstream [**SteveTheKiller/KillerPDF**](https://github.com/SteveTheKiller/KillerPDF) (through v1.6.2) and adapting them to TDPdf's diverged multi-tab architecture. This build ships everything merged to `main` since the last release, headlined by the changes below. See [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/doodlemania2/TDPdf/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the complete per-version history.

As always: this fork only exists because upstream KillerPDF is a genuinely great, dark-themed, no-telemetry, no-cloud Windows PDF editor. **Go star [the upstream project](https://github.com/SteveTheKiller/KillerPDF).**

## Highlights

### Reopen your documents on next launch (new in 1.17.0.0)
TDPdf now remembers the documents you had open and restores them as tabs the next time you launch, re-selecting the tab that was active. On quit it asks once whether to reopen next time, with a **"Remember my choice"** option that stops the prompt (Yes = always, No = never). Only real, saved files are remembered — untitled, merged, imported-image, and recovered documents are never persisted, a manually-closed tab does not come back, and choosing "No" clears the remembered list so no paths linger on disk. Opening a file directly (double-click or command line) takes precedence and opens on its own.

### Safer, friendlier PDF links (1.16.0.0)
- **Hardened link opening.** Clicking a URL in a PDF is now restricted to `http` / `https` / `mailto` links — a crafted `file://`, UNC, `javascript:`, or protocol-handler link can no longer be launched.
- **Confirm before opening** an external link (with the target shown) and a **"Don't ask again"** option.
- The link's destination is shown in the **status bar on hover**, and bare-domain links like `example.com` now open as `https://`.

### Printing no longer freezes the window (1.16.0.0)
Clicking Print now shows a progress scrim (spinner + "Preparing page X of N" → "Sending to printer…") and moves the 300 DPI re-rasterization onto a background thread, so the window keeps painting instead of going grey / "Not Responding" on large jobs. The preview also filters to the page range you type (type `6` → preview shows page 6).

### Page navigation (1.16.0.0)
**Page Up / Page Down** now move to the previous / next page consistently, even when a sidebar thumbnail has focus.

## Install / update
Download `TDPdf-v1.17.0.0-win-x64.exe` below — a single self-contained Windows x64 executable, no install required. Run it from anywhere, or let it offer to install per-user on first launch. Existing installations update in place.
